provenance.host: vedomosti.sssr.su. The SSSR.SU portal, which calls itself '(прообраз официального сайта)', is non-commercial and is registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345, 30 June 2010); it is not a state body or the publisher. The file is static (Apache; Last-Modified Sat, 19 Nov 2016 21:30:06 GMT). The host's index (https://vedomosti.sssr.su/) offers page-image PDFs only of 1991 Nos. 35, 36, 37, 38 and 41 and sends readers to naukaprava.ru (paid) for the other issues' scans; its HTML pages are a separate retyped transcription.
provenance.edition: Ведомости Верховного Совета СССР (the gazette's title from this issue), No. 41, 9 October 1991. The cover prints 'ISSN 0235-9936', '№ 41', '9 октября 1991 г.' and 'МОСКВА'; the contents page 'ГОД ИЗДАНИЯ 54-й'; the imprint (printed p. 1566, PDF p. 4) 'Еженедельное издание Верховного Совета СССР', 'Отдел опубликования актов Секретариата Верховного Совета СССР: 103795, ГСП, Москва, Центр, улица Чехова, 3' and 'Ордена Трудового Красного Знамени типография «Известий Советов народных депутатов СССР» имени И. И. Скворцова-Степанова', with '09.10.91' and 'Зак. 3978'; the back cover '20 к.' and 'Индекс 70163'. Arts. 1151-1164. PDF pp. 3-22 carry printed pp. 1565-1584 (running heads: PDF page + 1562); PDF pp. 1-2 and 23-24 are the covers (24 PDF pages).
provenance.relation_to_print: Full-page images of the printed issue, not a re-typeset text: every printed page (PDF pp. 3-22) is one 300 dpi bitonal page image (the covers are layered colour images), with an invisible OCR text layer made by ABBYY FineReader 11 (PDF metadata Producer). The images show the running heads, article numbers, signature, date and number blocks and the imprint as printed. The OCR layer is a search aid only, not a transcription of record: this review found it misreading printed characters (see corrections), so every quotation is checked against the image. PDF metadata Title 'Ведомости ВС СССР, № 41, 9 октября 1991', created 2 November 2016.
provenance.legibility: Cited PDF p. 20 (printed p. 1582), the cover and the imprint page rendered at 150 dpi (half the page images' native 300 dpi) and read: the decree's title, text, signature, date and number are legible.

source_review.content_comparison: The recorded bytes are unchanged. The cited PDF pages were rendered from them and read from the page images, not the OCR layer, and every quotation in the rows was compared with the image; dashes, the Roman numeral of act numbers and guillemets are normalised as elsewhere in this packet.

rows.text: Decree of the President of the USSR 'О переносе срока созыва сессии Верховного Совета Союза Советских Социалистических Республик нового состава' (art. 1162), 'Москва, Кремль. 3 октября 1991 г. № УП-2663': because the leaders of some republics reported that they could not complete forming their deputations by 8 October 1991, and under the Law of 5 September 1991, the first sitting of the new Supreme Soviet is moved to 21 October 1991 in Moscow.
